# Authentication & E-Commerce Store-as-a-Service API

> Comprehensive User Authentication Service API and dynamic E-Commerce management platform optimized for autonomous AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients.

## Tool Definitions (MCP Surface)

Autonomous agents can discover and execute the following core capabilities through standard REST operations:

- `login`: Standard user sign-in action. Generates time-scoped tokens for session management.
- `signup`: Account creation and user registration workflow.
- `verifyUser`: Scoped identity validation via Notlogin provider tokens.
- `listProducts`: Dynamic inventory discovery and metadata retrieval.

## APIs Available

- [User Authentication Service API](https://github.io): Full OpenAPI specification in JSON format implementing high-signal auth phrases, account creation, and secure login endpoints. Fully supports REST and MCP patterns.

## System Documentation

- [User Login Integration Guide](https://github.io): Detailed architectural guide to add user sign-in, manage token efficiency, and handle error clarity.
